rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-5: ONE knob -> pretrain_epochs 6 -> 12 (2x warm-start budget again). KEEP lr=1e-4 (the per-scan overfit anchor, iter-3 winner). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): iter-1 lr1e-3/n_iter400 SSIM 0.4785; iter-2 n_iter1200 0.4293 (more per-scan steps HURT -> per-image U-Net overfits each single noisy scan; n_iter RULED OUT); iter-3 lr1e-3->1e-4 0.4880 (+0.0095, the overfit-anchor lever -> per-scan fit pinned near the warm-start init); iter-4 pretrain_epochs 3->6 0.4957 (+0.0077, the BIGGEST gain, PSNR 16.13->16.29). The two confirmed levers on this dataset are (a) per-scan lr-down anchor and (b) warm-start init quality; n_iter is counterproductive and unet_c is explicitly warned against (solver design doc: capacity is NOT the lever for this loss; mayo n2i sibling c16->c32 flat 0.9508). With lr anchored at 1e-4 the per-scan fit barely moves off the warm-start init, so the warm-start init quality IS the operating point / binding constraint. iter-4 moved init quality MONOTONICALLY up (3ep 0.4880 -> 6ep 0.4957) with NO saturation/turn-over signal -- the lever still has slope. FAILURE MODE = warm-start init still under-converged at 6 epochs; the lr=1e-4 per-scan fit preserves but cannot improve a mediocre init, so a better-converged amortized GT-free N2I pre-pass directly raises the ceiling. LEVER CHOICE: of the two candidates, push pretrain_epochs (the lever that just gave the largest gain and is still climbing) rather than unet_c -- capacity is the warned-against axis and the mayo n2i sibling is already running the c16->c32 capacity probe, so keep the demo probe on the orthogonal init-budget lever instead of duplicating it. HYPOTHESIS: doubling the warm-start budget 6->12 epochs converges the amortized N2I init further, lifting SSIM above the 0.4957 iter-4 plateau toward the LD-FBP baseline (still structurally FBP-bounded on 128-view phantoms, so expect approach-to-baseline / small headroom, not a large jump). FALSIFIER: if SSIM is flat at ~0.495 the warm-start pre-pass has saturated by ~6ep and the init lever is exhausted -> iter-6 should pivot to the per-scan-anchor axis (warm_start sensitivity / seed / lr sweep around 1e-4) or accept the U-Net N2I ceiling and lean on the bilateral twin. WALL: warm 12x200=2400 + per-image 6x600=3600 = 6000 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 500 s (iter-4 was 370s at 4800 steps), well under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1200 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall. All other knobs IDENTICAL to iter-4 (train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16).
